csv_project_name: DB for James J. Rowley Training Center Auditorium annex
csv_agency: Department of Homeland Security, US Secret Service
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this project is to provide turn-key design build services to construct a Multifunction Auditorium annex. The annex shall be fitted out with advanced state of the art technology and systems, to the north side of the Merletti Facility located at the James J. Rowley Training Center in Laurel Maryland. This notice constitutes a Request for Information (RFI) Pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 15.201 for the purpose of determining the capability of sources in the marketplace for a contemplated effort for the Merletti Classroom Expansion. This RFI is for procurement planning purposes Only for eventual award and shall not be construed as a request for proposals/quotes, solicitation, or commitment on the part of the Government to issue any future solicitation or award.
